results.statement: B(x,y)=||y||x-||x||y is continuous, alternating, sector-null, O(n)-equivariant, nonzero, and positively 2-homogeneous for every n>=1.
Positive-ray quadratic response plus continuity, alternation, sector-nullness and full rotational covariance implies a joint Hessian/bilinearity and hence n=3.
Directional/Gateaux-type information is weaker than joint Frechet differentiability.
Seeded dimension audit through n=128 agrees with the exact counterfamily identities.
PDT primitives imply joint second-order Frechet regularity or an equivalent polarization law at the null state.
